publication_scope: Temporary collaboration evidence in docs/megamoe_train_migration; excluded from formal main/upstream delivery.
evidence_scope: One additional BF16-p NPU measurement compared with the previously recorded FP32-full-p measurement. FP32 NPU execution was not repeated for this diagnostic.

bf16_actual_p.values: FP32 full p rounded once to BF16

comparison_boundary.metric_source: Only the original ATK Actual_* metrics are compared. ATK actual/BigOp ratios are not used as cross-dtype accuracy gains.
comparison_boundary.dp_evaluation: The new BF16 dP and its BigOp counterpart are promoted losslessly to FP32 for an additional ATK evaluation against the same FP64 truth. The old FP32 dP was already evaluated as FP32. Raw BF16 dP metrics are excluded from gain arithmetic.
comparison_boundary.dp_attribution: The dP comparison includes the public gradient-return dtype difference; it does not isolate the extra mantissa bits of p alone.
comparison_boundary.rms_definition: Original private ATK RMS field; its normalization has not been independently established. It is not reported as absolute RMSE or pooled/global RMSE.
comparison_boundary.aggregation: Compute FP32/BF16 for each matching rank first, then report median and maximum ratio. Reduction percent is (1-ratio)*100. No tensor-error pooling across ranks.
comparison_boundary.old_fp32_input_and_truth_evidence: The old actual input tensors and golden hashes were not retained. Common-reference consistency relies on the frozen generator, identical case/seed and matching CPU producer binaries; equality with the old full-size golden was not verified bitwise.
comparison_boundary.new_reference_evidence: The wrapper verifies that BF16 actual p equals rounded full FP32 p and all non-p inputs are identical within the new generation, while leaving BF16 kernel and BigOp inputs unchanged.
comparison_boundary.source_identity_boundary: Installed full-wheel members and startup native loading were verified. Per-rank native memory mappings were not captured.
comparison_boundary.qualification_scope: Additional common-full-p-reference diagnostic; original per-input qualification decisions remain separate and unchanged.
comparison_boundary.claim_limit: One shape, fixed routing and upstream gradients. Improvements do not imply every maximum-relative-error value improves or establish training loss convergence.

cpu_metric_dtype_probe.scope: CPU-only black-box control using identical BF16-representable actual values and the same FP64 truth, evaluated under BF16 and FP32 storage dtypes. This tests these samples, not a universal formula.
